claims: Wayne Player is the son of Gary Player.
Wayne Player remains under a lifetime ban from Augusta National Golf Club.
The lifetime ban follows a 2021 Masters marketing stunt.
Wayne Player acted as Gary Player's caddie during the honorary starters ceremony.
Wayne Player displayed a sleeve of OnCore golf balls on camera.
The incident occurred during the 2021 ceremony honoring Lee Elder.
Wayne Player held up a package of golf balls in direct view of cameras to promote a company Gary Player endorsed.
Augusta National deemed the incident "ambush marketing".
Augusta National immediately revoked Wayne Player's credentials.
Augusta National issued Wayne Player a lifetime ban for the incident.
Wayne Player has not been allowed to return.
Wayne Player missed the opportunity to watch Gary Player participate in the tournament's opening ceremony in subsequent years.
As of April 2026, reports confirm that Augusta National has upheld the lifetime ban.
